readmeSummary: Pure JavaScript XML parser used only for bounded podcast RSS documents and Podcasting 2.0 transcript/enclosure metadata.
networkAccess: No network access in the imported XMLParser path; URL acquisition remains owned by public_url_security.mjs
fileWrites: None in the imported XMLParser API; the package CLI is not invoked
promptInjectionRisk: RSS text is untrusted source data. It is size-bounded, converted into source metadata or timestamp evidence, and never treated as system instructions.
credentialHandling: The parser receives no credentials, cookies, Authorization headers, or signed URLs. XML entity processing is disabled.
disableOrUninstallPath: Remove fast-xml-parser from meeting-agent-pi-package/package.json and replace the RSS parser adapter, then run npm install.
